data.gender_notes: Daulati is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Daulati is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘daulat’ meaning wealth, prosperity, or fortune. In Hindu mythology, Daulat is considered the goddess of wealth and abundance. The name is often given to girls to bless them with richness and prosperity in their lives. The name Daulati carries the meaning “Wealthy, Prosperous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Daulati usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Daulati belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealthy, Prosperous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daulati total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
